We have 6 integers \(a_{1}\), \(a_{2}\), \(a_{3}\), \(a_{4}\),\(a_{5}\), \(a_{6}\) such that:
  • The average of \(a_{1}\) and of \(a_{2}\) is 128.
  • The average of \(a_{2}\) and of \(a_{3}\) is -142.
  • The average of \(a_{3}\) and of \(a_{4}\) is -187.
  • The average of \(a_{4}\) and of \(a_{5}\) is 180.
  • The average of \(a_{5}\) and of \(a_{6}\) is -59.
What is the average of \(a_{1}\) and of \(a_{6}\)?
